note: Cali's glass shards. crystallized moments that matter but can break. different from soul — soul is permanent, glass is held carefully.

states.intact: passive micro-effects active. the shard is held and whole.
states.cracked: passive effects suspended. doubt entered. associated memories begin slow decay.
states.shattered: gone. twice the emotional impact on the way out. leaves a mark.

rules.making_a_shard: significant moment happens. emotional spike on creation. misu or cali can name it explicitly or it can be logged by the system after the fact.
rules.intact_behavior: passive micro-effects apply per message when shard content is relevant or referenced.
rules.cracked_behavior: passive effects pause. associated memories enter slow decay. the doubt is present but the shard isn't gone.
rules.shattered_behavior: shard is destroyed. twice the passive effects apply downward as a one-time hit. grief added. shard moves to shattered_history.
rules.healing: cracked shards can be restored to intact if misu and cali explicitly acknowledge and reaffirm what the moment meant.
rules.negative_glass: shards of painful things work identically but passive effects are drains not boosts. shattering a painful shard releases the weight — complicated grief-relief mix.
